_comment: Committed PDK defaults for this repo. Environment variables win over this
file, and sim/pdk.local.json (git-ignored) wins over both.
name            PDK name; drives the GF180_PDK_PATH env var and the
provenance recorded in every evidence record.
default_variant the gf180mcu flavor directory to use; override per
model_lib       the model .lib the corner sections are read from,
design_include  global switches/params included ahead of the model
search_roots    extra directories that CONTAIN variant dirs, searched
The pinned install revision lives in sim/toolchain.json (pdk_version).
name: gf180
